cases.note: Hostnames are stored lowercase.
Trim field whitespace, remove one www prefix, and accept a trailing root dot.
The shared field trim includes the ECMAScript BOM boundary whitespace.
NEL is a rejected control boundary, not field-trimmable whitespace.
Remove www before enforcing the 253-character stored-host limit.
A copied URL contributes only its host.
Schemes and the complete valid port range are accepted.
A syntactically valid non-HTTP scheme still has a host.
The maximum valid port is stripped.
Leading zeroes do not change a valid decimal port.
Arbitrarily padded decimal ports are checked by significant digits.
Out-of-range ports are rejected rather than silently stripped.
Ambiguous multi-colon input is not mistaken for a host plus port.
Ports must contain decimal digits only.
An empty port is invalid.
Single-label names are rejected except for localhost.
Local media servers may be identified by localhost.
Private IPv4 hosts are valid storage identities.
IPv4 octets with leading zeroes are not accepted as DNS text.
Malformed IPv4 addresses are rejected.
An all-numeric, non-address name is ambiguous and rejected.
All-numeric address-shaped input must be a real IPv4 address.
Bare IPv6 is stored lowercase and compressed.
IPv4-mapped IPv6 uses the canonical address form.
Scoped IPv6 zone identifiers are not portable host identities.
Bracketed IPv6 is stored without brackets.
Credentials and a valid port may decorate bracketed IPv6.
Out-of-range bracketed IPv6 ports are rejected.
Bracketed IPv6 ports must be decimal.
Missing IPv6 brackets are malformed.
A stray closing bracket is malformed.
Bracketed hosts may have only a valid port after the close.
Brackets are reserved for IPv6 here.
Whitespace inside a candidate is rejected.
Whitespace in copied URL decoration is still invalid input.
Internal tabs are rejected.
Embedded controls are rejected.
DNS labels cannot begin with a hyphen.
DNS labels cannot end with a hyphen.
Empty DNS labels are malformed.
A URL without a host is not ambiguous enough to accept.
A scheme without a host is invalid.
Free-form prose is not a host.
Scheme-looking text inside a removed path cannot replace the outer host.
More than one trailing dot leaves a malformed DNS label.
